measurement_limitations: Finite observations on one nonexclusive reported x86_64 host and one operator; no authenticated hardware, ARM/GPU/ASIC execution, joules or WAN bandwidth.
Counts are sums after per-job deduplication, not a globally unique set across counterfactual jobs or the two campaigns.
The miner budget includes this implementation’s complete proof serialization and local output flush; that diagnostic representation/sink is not an enforced minimum attacker cost.
Setup includes original Node acquisition observers; the separated online miner has no receiver/audit feedback. Setup plus miner is a measured rate, not equal-total-budget optimization.
Only two development task materials, four named algorithms, two seeds, and one/four ancestors on a paid path; no arbitrary fork forest, perpetual preprocessing or optimal adaptive selector.
Hot/cold are arithmetic-preparation policies; processor caches were not forcibly flushed and CPU affinity does not provide exclusive hardware.
A proof available by B and eventually admitted is not an admission completed by B, canonical growth, mature reward or network throughput.
A named-stage residual is unclassified observed CPU; it must not be automatically labeled logging or removed from the denominator.

Observed research headers cover only T=2^255-1 and work=2; p=1/2 is induced only under the explicitly assumed fresh conditional-uniform digest model, not established by measurement. No variable-difficulty resource-to-chain-security claim follows.
The first campaign, reader environment rejections, setup errors, gate failures and all negative results remain separate retained evidence.
Finite tests and exact conditional models do not prove actual SHA-256 instantiation, multi-instance hardness, a physical floor, production kappa or model improvement.
